name: Websites
text: A site is a document of pages and sections, drafted, previewed and published.

name: Blog
text: Markdown in, a fast static page out, cached and paced so a crawl never takes it down.

name: VayuMail
text: Your own mail server, with the records it needs checked for you, and any mail app.

name: VayuTalk
text: Private chat on your own domain, shared by a link, with nothing in between.

name: Tor Space
text: An onion address for the same site, with its own world in the console.

name: VayuShield
text: Bots, floods and scrapers turned away before they cost a query, every verdict explained.

name: VayuAnalytics
text: Visitors counted on the server, with no cookie and no address kept, every figure explained.

name: VayuAPI
text: Keys that can do exactly what they are given, section by section, and nothing else.

text: Connect an AI client to your site in one click, with the same scoped permissions.

text: One console for all of it, one per site, installable on any screen.
